subject: Amberfield vendor activation — banking details + PO / remittance process
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Soto <emily.soto@amberfield.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Amberfield vendor activation — banking details + PO / remittance process

Hi Emily —

Welcome — we're getting Amberfield set up in our finance systems so we can start processing POs and vendor payments. To activate your vendor record and enable ACH/Wire payments, can you reply with the following items? I attached a short BankingInfo_Template.xlsx to make it easier.

Required for vendor activation:
- Preferred payment method: ACH (US) or Wire (international) — indicate both if you support both.
- Bank name / branch
- Account holder name (exact legal name)
- Account type (Checking/Savings)
- Routing number (for ACH) / SWIFT or IBAN (for wire)
- Account number / last 4 (if you prefer, we can accept bank letter or voided check)
- Remittance email (where payment notifications should be sent)
- Invoice submission method: email invoice to accounting@amberfield.co OR upload to vendor portal (link below)
- Tax form: Completed W-9 (U.S. vendors) — please attach

Redwood-specific instructions:
- We require a PO number on every invoice. Please reference the PO# in the invoice header and on the remittance line.
- Standard payment terms for this agreement are Net 30 from invoice receipt unless otherwise negotiated. If Amberfield requests alternate terms, note that in your reply and we will escalate.
- Remit-to address for checks (if needed) — include mailing address if you accept paper checks.

Next steps once we receive the documents: Finance will validate the bank details (micro-deposit or bank letter) and then we will issue the first PO through our procurement system. If you prefer a supplier portal option where you can upload invoices directly, let us know and we can provision access (portal requires a quick identity verification).

Attachments: BankingInfo_Template.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Amberfield vendor activation — banking details + PO / remittance process

Hi Emily —

Thanks — this is great and should let us move quickly. A few quick clarifications and what to expect from our side:

1) Bank verification: Our finance team prefers micro-deposits for ACH verification — we will initiate two small deposits (will take 1–2 business days). If you'd rather provide a bank letter, let us know and we'll pause micro-deposits.

2) Remittance email: confirmed as remittance@amberfield.co — we'll ensure payment advices and remittance files go there.

3) PO expectations: Redwood will issue a PO for each engagement. Please include PO# on the invoice header. If your AR system cannot capture a PO on upload, include it in the invoice body and subject line of the email.

4) Portal option: We can provision supplier portal access for Amberfield to upload invoices and see PO statuses. Portal requires a short verification (ID + bank verification). Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/suppliers/amberfield-activation (portal provisioning request).

5) Timing: Once finance confirms bank verification and we have the W-9 on file, first PO should be issued within 3 business days. Payment terms per contract are Net 30. If Amberfield needs an earlier payment cadence, we can evaluate on a per-PO basis.

Attachments: BankingInfo_Template.xlsx (record updated)

I'll flag Priyom to run the verification.

— Jordan

Hi Jordan / Priyom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We confirm the remittance email and will monitor for the micro-deposits. A couple quick asks:
- Expected PO cadence: will Redwood issue a single consolidated PO per month or individual POs per campaign? We can accept either, but need PO# on invoices to automate postings.
- If you issue consolidated POs, please stipulate invoice numbering expectations (e.g., include parent PO and line references).

Otherwise Amberfield is ready to proceed. I will follow up if we see any issues with micro-deposits.

Regards,
Emily
